_comment: Firm-owned configuration. Fill these before launch. Empty values hide the related element and print a build warning. Never commit secrets here; everything in this file is public in the built site.
name: Metanoia Advisory

forms._comment: provider: netlify (default on Netlify hosting, no keys needed), web3forms (paste the access key from web3forms.com, or set WEB3FORMS_KEY in the host's environment variables), formspree (paste the form IDs from formspree.io), hubspot (uses the hubspot block above) or none. On Cloudflare Pages, 'netlify' switches to web3forms by itself, because Netlify Forms only works on Netlify.

analytics._comment: Cookieless analytics, loaded without consent because nothing is stored on the visitor's device. Cloudflare Web Analytics (free): either turn on automatic setup for the domain in the Cloudflare dashboard (Analytics & Logs, Web Analytics), or paste the site token here. plausibleDomain: the site domain registered at plausible.io (paid). Leave both empty for none.

offers._comment: Published prices. Leave a price empty and the page says the fee is fixed and confirmed before work starts. Example: { "en": "Rp 15 million, excluding VAT", "id": "Rp 15 juta, belum termasuk PPN" }.

uploads._comment: Decks attached to the Deck Audit and deck-review forms, stored privately in Cloudflare R2 by functions/api/upload.js. Leave enabled false until the R2 bucket, its binding (DECKS) and its lifecycle rule (delete after retentionDays) exist: see docs/operations-playbook.md. retentionDays is printed on the forms and in the privacy policy, so it must match the lifecycle rule. turnstileSiteKey: optional bot check (pair it with TURNSTILE_SECRET in Cloudflare). UPLOADS=1 in the build environment also switches uploads on.

tools._comment: deckCheck: the free in-browser deck check. 'preview' builds the page at its address but keeps it out of search engines, the sitemap and the site's own links, so it can be tried on real decks first. 'live' links it from the Deck Audit page and the footer. 'off' does not build it. headlineCheck: the free headline checker, same three modes.
